payload.title: Both merge-lane call sites of merge_record.record_merge omit merge_sha, merged_at and merged_head_sha although the merge state they hold carries them, so a lane-merged row has no merge commit: its change review gets no hunks and outcome_truth's revert test is skipped
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/merge_authority.py:481-482 (record_merge called with pr, merged_by, cycle_id and head_lineage only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/merge_authority.py:572-573 (the queue-settled path passes the same short argument list)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/merge_record.py:542-549 (the row stamps merge_sha, merged_at and head_sha only when the caller supplies them)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/auto_merge.py:1252 (get_merge_state already returns merge_commit_sha, and merge_outcome keeps it under observed)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:187-205 (a merged row without merge_sha yields 'hunks not attached: the merged row records no merge_sha')
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/outcome_truth.py:101-108 (a row without merge_sha skips the revert test and returns None, read as merged and not reverted)
payload.rule_violated: merge_record is the one owner of the merged row (ARIA-HIGH-390); a row of that owner that omits the merge identity makes every reader of the row guess.
payload.notes: When the merge lane merges an L1 PR, record_merge writes the merged row from the pre-merge PR payload and the passed lineage only, so merge_sha, merged_at and the merged head are absent although merge_result['observed'] holds them. pr_tracking then mints the change-intelligence envelope for ARIA's own merge with no diff, and outcome_truth._merged_not_reverted treats a lane merge that self_revert later reverted (revert key revert:<merge_sha>) as a fix that held, because the sha it would test is missing. The lane runs only on an operator grant (L1), so this is reachable on the first lane merge. Plan row: F3.3a + F3.4 (the audit states it is built and unpushed at .worktrees/f33a). Close condition: merge_authority passes merge_sha, merged_at and merged_head_sha from merge_result['observed'] at both call sites; a test settles a lane merge on a fake adapter and asserts the merged row carries merge_sha, and a second test asserts outcome_truth._merged_not_reverted returns 'self_reverted' for a reverted lane merge (both red today); an invariant pins that no merged row is written without merge_sha. Plan row: F3.3a and F3.4 (built, not pushed). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
